item.title: IKN Clinches IDR 6.56T Investment, Targets Political Capital by 2028
item.description: IKN Authority secured IDR 6.56T for civil servant housing and 5 private projects, targeting Nusantara as the political capital by 2028 amid global interest.
item.content:encoded:
IDR 6.56 Trillion for Civil Servant Housing

The Nusantara Capital City Authority (OIKN - Otorita Ibu Kota Nusantara) has secured investment commitments totaling IDR 6.56 trillion to expedite the construction of State Civil Apparatus (ASN - Aparatur Sipil Negara) housing and urban support facilities. The announcement was delivered by Head of OIKN Basuki Hadimuljono in Nusantara, East Kalimantan, on Thursday (15/10/2026).

The total combines public-private partnership projects and purely private funding. A total of eight ASN flat (rusun - rumah susun) towers worth IDR 2.63 trillion will be built across 6.84 hectares in Planning Area 1A of the Central Government Core Area (KIPP - Kawasan Inti Pusat Pemerintahan), initiated by PT Nindya Karya.

In addition, 109 landed house units for ASN valued at IDR 2.81 trillion are being developed by PT Seratus Sembilan Nusantara—an implementing business entity of PT Intiland Development Tbk—under a Public-Private Partnership (KPBU - Kerja Sama Pemerintah dan Badan Usaha) scheme signed on October 6, 2026, targeting completion in the fourth quarter of 2028.

Five Private Investors Develop Urban Facilities

OIKN also signed five purely private direct investments worth a total of IDR 1.11 trillion to bolster urban lifestyle amenities. The largest undertaking is Grand Vista Nusantara by PT Indonesia Belt Road High Tech Development Park—an integrated commercial, apartment, and office complex valued at around IDR 1 trillion.

The other four comprise: PT Berdikari (Persero) constructing an IDR 177 billion integrated poultry farm with a capacity of 140,000 birds to strengthen municipal food security; PT FYP Karya Perdana building an IDR 20 billion sports facility and commercial center; PT Laziz Nusantara Grup presenting an IDR 10 billion restaurant, gelato outlet, and multipurpose hall; as well as PT Java Teak Indo opening an IDR 1.5 billion office and Jepara-style specialty furniture showroom.

Construction Progress: Garuda Palace Enters Finishing

Phase I construction of IKN has reached 100 percent completion. Several strategic undertakings continue at full throttle: the Coordinating Ministry offices stand at 80-90 percent progress, Garuda Palace has entered the interior finishing phase, while ASN and Defense and Security (Hankam - Pertahanan dan Keamanan) flats average 70-85 percent.

Green infrastructure is also being built: a 50 MW Solar Power Plant (PLTS - Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Surya) that generates around 93 GWh annually and reduces 104,000 tons of carbon emissions, alongside an Integrated Waste Treatment Facility (TPST - Tempat Pengolahan Sampah Terpadu) with a capacity of 84 tons per day operating on a zero-waste concept. The government aims for IKN to officially function as Indonesia's political capital by 2028.

Blended Financing and the Global Spotlight

Basuki emphasized that building the new capital is not entirely borne by the State Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBN - Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara). Beyond the 2025-2028 APBN allocation of IDR 48.8 trillion, confirmed investments via the KPBU scheme stand at IDR 158.73 trillion, complemented by purely private investments of around IDR 66.5 trillion.

"Today we prove that IKN's development is not funded solely by the APBN. Today there are also two KPBU projects and five private investments whose construction will commence immediately," Basuki stated.

International attention has likewise surged: 42 delegates from eight Asian nations and Australia—including Japan, South Korea, Singapore, and Australia—directly inspected KIPP Nusantara on October 5, 2026, observing firsthand the forest city, sponge city, and smart city frameworks championed by IKN.

item.title: Como Thrash Manchester United 4-1 as Nico Paz Scores Brace
item.description: Como 1907 beat Manchester United 4-1 on Champions League matchday 3 at Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia early on Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB. Nico Paz scored a brace (2', 57') and added an assist, with goals from Anastasios Douvikas (49') and Jacobo Ramón (76'); Joshua Zirkzee netted United's consolation in the 90+1st minute. The win lifted Como to sixth with 6 points, while United slumped to 20th.
item.content:encoded:
Paz Stars in Como's Historic Win

Como 1907 claimed a historic victory in their debut Champions League season. Playing at Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia early on Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB, Cesc Fàbregas' side thrashed Manchester United 4-1 on Champions League 2026/2027 league-phase matchday 3.

Nico Paz was the star of the night. The young Argentina midfielder opened the scoring just two minutes in with a curling shot from the edge of the box, set up by Lucas da Cunha. The early goal sent the Sinigaglia crowd into delirium and put United immediately on the back foot.

Como doubled their lead just after the break. In the 49th minute, Anastasios Douvikas latched onto Paz's through ball and lobbed goalkeeper Senne Lammens. Eight minutes later, Paz was on the scoresheet again — capitalising on a defensive error before firing an unstoppable left-footed shot. Jacobo Ramón completed the rout with a header in the 76th minute, before Joshua Zirkzee netted a stoppage-time consolation for United.

United's Crisis Deepens

The heavy defeat deepened Manchester United's crisis. Michael Carrick's side are enduring their worst start in 40 years and now languish in 20th place in the league-phase standings. United have won only one of their last 11 away Champions League matches.

In another damning statistic, United became the first English team to concede inside the opening two minutes of consecutive major European matches — after Pablo Barrios scored in the first minute for Atlético Madrid last week. Carrick, forced to field a heavily reshuffled line-up due to an injury crisis, now faces huge pressure over his future, with this weekend's trip to Bournemouth described as decisive.

Anastasios Douvikas continued his fine form with his third goal in three Champions League matches this season. United, in contrast, have now conceded six goals and scored just one in their last two European outings — a record that sums up the Red Devils' fragile defence.

Como Climb Into the Top Six

The win lifted Como to sixth in the standings with six points from three matches — a remarkable return for a club playing in Italy's fourth tier just seven years ago. Fàbregas praised his players' fearless mentality against a club of United's stature.

For Nico Paz, the performance further cemented his status as one of Europe's brightest young talents. The Argentina international was directly involved in three of Como's four goals — two goals and one assist — and is reportedly heating up the race for the playmaker role in the Argentina squad.

Como will look to keep the momentum going as the competition continues, while United must bounce back quickly to avoid an early exit from the race for the next round.

item.title: Galatasaray Comeback to Beat Lille 4-2, Osimhen Nets vs Former Club
item.description: Galatasaray beat Lille 4-2 on Champions League matchday 3 at Stade Pierre-Mauroy early on Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB. Goals from Yunus Akgün (2'), Aleksey Batrakov (44'), a Berke Özer own goal (52') and Victor Osimhen (61') overturned the hosts' 2-1 lead earned through Soriba Diaoune's brace (7', 39'). Galatasaray's first win of the season ended a run of five straight away defeats.
item.content:encoded:
Six Goals in a Pulsating Thriller

Galatasaray claimed their first Champions League win of the season in dramatic fashion. Visiting Stade Pierre-Mauroy early on Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB, Okan Buruk's side beat Lille 4-2 on Champions League 2026/2027 league-phase matchday 3 in a six-goal thriller.

The game was just two minutes old when Yunus Akgün put Galatasaray ahead. Lille responded quickly through Soriba Diaoune, who levelled in the 7th minute from Alexsandro's pass. The Lille striker struck again in the 39th minute to turn the game around and give the hosts a 2-1 lead.

But Lille's lead vanished before half-time. Aleksey Batrakov headed home Roland Sallai's cross in the 44th minute to make it 2-2. Seven minutes after the restart, disaster struck the hosts: goalkeeper Berke Özer failed to deal with a corner situation and the ball went into his own net. Victor Osimhen sealed the 4-2 win with a powerful strike in the 61st minute from Barış Alper Yılmaz's assist.

Osimhen Haunts His Former Club

Osimhen's goal carried extra meaning as Lille are his former club. The Nigeria striker muted his celebration out of respect for the home crowd. Earlier, Osimhen had nearly scored sooner, but his penalty award in the 27th minute was overturned after the referee's VAR review found no foul.

Although Lille dominated with 56% possession and 15 shots, Galatasaray's ruthless efficiency proved decisive. All four of the visitors' shots on target ended up in the net — a deadly display of finishing.

Soriba Diaoune was the hosts' best player with his brace, each goal the product of fine link-up play with Alexsandro and Hákon Arnar Haraldsson. Unfortunately, the striker's double was not enough to save Lille from defeat.

First Win for Gala, Lille Sink Deeper

The victory ended Galatasaray's run of five consecutive away defeats in the Champions League and earned them their first three points of the season. Lille, in contrast, suffered a third straight home defeat in UEFA competition and remain pointless — a disappointing start for Bruno Génésio's side.

Galatasaray can now push up the league-phase standings, while Lille must regroup quickly to keep their qualification hopes alive. Both teams still have five matches left to decide their fate in Europe's elite competition this season.

item.title: Real Madrid Thrash RB Leipzig 4-1, Perfect in Champions League
item.description: Real Madrid beat RB Leipzig 4-1 on Champions League matchday 3 at the Santiago Bernabéu, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB. Goals from Bernardo Silva (44'), Arda Güler (52'), Kylian Mbappé (83') and Yan Diomande (87') sealed Madrid's perfect start; Tidiam Gomis scored Leipzig's consolation in the 85th minute. Diomande broke Opta's record as Madrid's youngest substitute to score and assist in a single UCL match.
item.content:encoded:
Silva's Late Opener Breaks the Deadlock

Real Madrid continued their perfect start to the 2026/2027 Champions League. At the Santiago Bernabéu, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB, Los Blancos thrashed RB Leipzig 4-1 on league-phase matchday 3.

The first half was cagey. Thibaut Courtois was forced into a superb save to deny Romulo Cardoso, while Vinicius Junior — playing the full match while serving a four-game LaLiga ban — also failed to beat Maarten Vandevoordt. The deadlock was broken in the 44th minute: Arda Güler's shot from Federico Valverde's cutback was parried by Vandevoordt, and Bernardo Silva pounced on the rebound for his first Madrid goal since joining from Manchester City last summer.

Güler, Mbappé and Diomande's Record

Madrid doubled their lead seven minutes after the restart. In the 52nd minute, Güler guided the ball over the line with the faintest of touches after Kylian Mbappé headed Jude Bellingham's cross back across goal.

Mbappé finally got on the scoresheet in the 83rd minute with an individual effort from the edge of the area. Leipzig pulled one back two minutes later through Tidiam Gomis, but Yan Diomande — on for Vinicius — sealed the rout with a volley into the top corner in the 87th minute. According to Opta, Diomande became Real Madrid's youngest substitute to score and assist in a single Champions League match, breaking the record held by Guti since 1999.

Perfect Platform Ahead of El Clásico

The win gave Madrid a perfect nine points from three league-phase matches, coinciding with 100 days since José Mourinho's return for his second spell in charge. Without a major trophy in two seasons and a shaky domestic start, the flawless European record is welcome relief.

Mourinho again deployed Valverde at right-back and trusted Eduardo Camavinga in midfield. A fourth straight win in all competitions is ideal preparation for this weekend's El Clásico against Barcelona — rivals freshly humbled 4-2 by Paris Saint-Germain.

item.title: Allianz Arena Drama: Bayern Held 2-2 by Arsenal
item.description: Bayern Munich drew 2-2 with Arsenal on Champions League matchday 3 at the Allianz Arena, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB. Eberechi Eze (25') put Arsenal ahead, Alphonso Davies (35') levelled, Harry Kane's penalty (61') put Bayern in front, and Declan Rice (82') earned the draw. Arsenal stretched their unbeaten league-phase run to 15; Bayern preserved a 39-game home unbeaten UCL run since 2013.
item.content:encoded:
Eze Capitalises After Saka Injury

Arsenal lost Bukayo Saka early at the Allianz Arena, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB. The England winger was forced off in the 10th minute with a non-contact left quad injury, and his replacement — Eberechi Eze — opened the scoring instead.

In the 25th minute, Eze stayed onside to meet Martin Ødegaard's measured long pass with a volley into the far corner past Manuel Neuer. The Gunners held the lead until ten minutes before half-time, when Alphonso Davies levelled on a swift counter-attack from Harry Kane's through ball.

Kane Penalty Cancelled Out by Rice

Bayern turned the game around in the 61st minute. The referee pointed to the spot after Kane's shot struck Jurriën Timber's hand, and Kane converted calmly — his 10th consecutive Champions League match with a goal.

Arsenal refused to lose. In the 82nd minute, Declan Rice burst into the box to meet Viktor Gyökeres' flick and fired a low drive into the far corner. The 2-2 scoreline held until full time, extending Arsenal's unbeaten run to 15 straight league-phase matches — including the whole of last season.

Bayern's Home Record Survives

The draw keeps both sides unbeaten in this season's league phase. Bayern also preserved a remarkable record: 39 home matches unbeaten in the Champions League group/league phase since 2013.

For Arsenal, a point in Bavaria is a confidence boost. Last season's finalists took the lead first and then came from behind through Rice's late strike, though they paid a price with Saka's injury awaiting further assessment.

item.title: Inter Edge Shakhtar 1-0 Despite Playing with 10 Men
item.description: Inter Milan beat Shakhtar Donetsk 1-0 on Champions League matchday 3 at the Giuseppe Meazza, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB. Carlos Augusto scored the only goal in the 77th minute from Henrikh Mkhitaryan's assist, even though Inter played with 10 men after Alessandro Bastoni's 68th-minute dismissal. Inter's first win this season lifted them to 3 points.
item.content:encoded:
Bastoni Sent Off, Inter Still Win

Inter Milan earned their first Champions League win of the season in dramatic fashion. At the Giuseppe Meazza, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB, the Nerazzurri beat Shakhtar Donetsk 1-0 despite playing with 10 men for more than 20 minutes.

Disaster struck in the 68th minute when Alessandro Bastoni received a second yellow card and had to leave the pitch. Coach Cristian Chivu was forced to reshuffle his defence, yet the decisive goal came from that difficult situation.

Carlos Augusto's Stunning Winner

In the 77th minute, Henrikh Mkhitaryan — on for just two minutes in place of Ange-Yoan Bonny — made an instant impact. With his first touch, the Armenian midfielder threaded a precise through ball to Carlos Augusto.

The Brazilian wing-back calmly beat goalkeeper Dmytro Riznyk with an outside-of-the-left-foot finish through the keeper's legs, sending San Siro into raptures. Inter almost doubled the lead through Marcus Thuram, who had squandered several chances earlier, but the 1-0 scoreline held until the end.

First Three Points

The victory lifted Inter to three points after back-to-back defeats in the opening two matchdays. Still far from the safe zone, the first three points keep the Nerazzurri's hopes alive in the league phase.

Brave Shakhtar left empty-handed. The Ukrainian side threatened several times through Mykola Matviyenko and Newerton, but blunt finishing meant they failed to snatch a point in Milan.

item.title: Lisbon Shock: LASK Linz Stun Sporting CP 3-2
item.description: Sporting CP lost 2-3 to LASK Linz on Champions League matchday 3 at the José Alvalade, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB. Luis Suárez put Sporting ahead with a 5th-minute penalty and scored again in the 89th minute, but goals from Christoph Lang (15'), Saša Kalajdžić (63') and Kryštof Daněk (68') gave LASK a historic away win — their first three points in the league phase.
item.content:encoded:
Suárez Puts Sporting Ahead

Sporting CP suffered a shock home defeat. At the José Alvalade in Lisbon, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB, the Portuguese giants lost 2-3 to LASK Linz on Champions League league-phase matchday 3.

The hosts started perfectly. In the 5th minute, Colombian striker Luis Suárez opened the scoring from the penalty spot. But the lead lasted only ten minutes — Christoph Lang equalised in the 15th minute, and the 1-1 scoreline held until half-time.

LASK's Deadly Five Minutes

The second half was a nightmare for Sporting. In the 63rd minute, Saša Kalajdžić put LASK ahead from Robert Ljubičić's assist. Five minutes later, Kryštof Daněk extended the visitors' lead to 3-1 via Samuel Adeniran's pass.

Painfully for coach Rui Borges: LASK turned 1-1 into 3-1 before Sporting made their first substitution. Suárez pulled one back with his second goal in the 89th minute, but there was not enough time for the hosts to find an equaliser.

Historic Three Points for LASK

The victory was LASK's first three points in the league phase after back-to-back defeats — a historic haul for the Austrian club that qualified dramatically via the playoff against Celtic. Sporting are stuck on six points and must bounce back quickly.

For D. Kühbauer's LASK, an away win over a club of Sporting's stature is a statement. They proved that even small teams can win on Europe's biggest stage with disciplined organisation and clinical finishing.

item.title: Aston Villa Beat Viking 3-1, Join PSG at the Summit
item.description: Aston Villa beat Viking 3-1 on Champions League matchday 3 at Villa Park, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB. Ross Barkley's goal (23'), Emiliano Buendía's penalty (37') and Henrik Heggheim's own goal (62') put Villa 3-0 up; Peter Christiansen scored Viking's consolation in the 84th minute. Villa made it three wins from three with 9 points, level with PSG at the top of the table.
item.content:encoded:
Barkley and Buendía Put Villa Ahead

Aston Villa continued their perfect Champions League start. At Villa Park, early Thursday (22/10/2026) WIB, Unai Emery's side beat Viking 3-1 on league-phase matchday 3.

Villa opened the scoring in the 23rd minute. Ross Barkley glanced Ibrahim Mbaye's corner into the top corner with a looping header. In the 37th minute, Emiliano Buendía doubled the lead from the spot — the penalty awarded after a VAR review for Zlatko Tripic's foul on Alysson. The goal made Buendía the first Villa player to score in four consecutive European appearances.

Own Goal and Viking Consolation

Villa added a third in the 62nd minute. The impressive Alysson raced into the penalty area and delivered a low cross that Henrik Heggheim diverted into his own net.

Viking — who held Bayern Munich 3-3 last matchweek — finally broke through in the 84th minute. Peter Christiansen's goal was initially ruled out for offside, but allowed to stand after review. The 3-1 scoreline held until full time.

Level with PSG at the Top

The win gave Villa nine points from three matches — level with Paris Saint-Germain at the top of the table, behind only on goal difference. Villa had previously beaten Club Brugge 3-2 and thrashed Fenerbahçe 6-0, the biggest European victory in club history.

Emery made five second-half substitutions — including bringing on Alejandro Garnacho — in preparation for this weekend's heavyweight clash with Manchester City. With a tougher schedule ahead, this perfect start is an important foundation for Villa.

item.title: Police Name 11 Firms Forest Fire Suspects, Including 3 Foreign Cos
item.description: National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto named 11 firms, including three foreign-owned companies in Kalimantan, forest fire suspects in Jakarta on Wednesday.
item.content:encoded:
National Police Chief Names 11 Corporate Suspects

Chief of the Indonesian National Police (Kapolri) General Suyudi Ario Seto announced that the National Police (Polri) have named 11 corporations as suspects in forest and land fires (karhutla) cases. Of that total, three are foreign investment companies (PMA - Penanaman Modal Asing).

"We have named 11 corporate suspects. Three of them are foreign investment companies, while the process is still ongoing," Suyudi said after attending a Plenary Cabinet Meeting at the Jakarta Presidential Palace compound on Wednesday (10/21/2026).

The naming of suspects marks an escalation in forest fire law enforcement to the corporate level, following earlier police focuses on individual reports and administrative sanctions issued by the Ministry of Forestry.

Identities Withheld, 3 Foreign Firms in Kalimantan

Despite designating suspects, Suyudi has not yet disclosed the identities of the 11 corporations bearing suspect status. "It will be explained later," he told reporters.

The National Police Chief confirmed that the three foreign companies implicated are based in Kalimantan. He mentioned that ties with parties from several nations are still being examined by investigators, though details regarding the countries involved have not been made public.

Suyudi emphasized that the investigation into the corporations allegedly involved in forest fires has proceeded smoothly. He also stated that legal accountability would be traced directly to company owners and shareholders responsible for the corporate activities.

Prabowo: Environmental Terrorism, Revoke Violators' Permits

President Prabowo Subianto affirmed that forest and land fires must not be taken lightly. He described forest and land burning as a form of environmental terrorism and a crime against humanity, given the health hazards posed to millions of Indonesian citizens.

In his opening remarks at the Plenary Cabinet Meeting, Prabowo instructed the police, the prosecutor's office, and the Ministry of Forestry—supported by the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI) and intelligence services—to investigate and take decisive action against all perpetrators, both individuals and corporations. He also firmly stated that permits would be revoked for all firms proven to have committed violations.

The firm order followed findings indicating that forest fires are not solely natural occurrences, but involve human intervention and corporate complicity across several regions.

Context: 98 Corporate Cases Under Investigation

Previously, on Monday (10/19/2026), the National Police Chief stated that Polri was examining 98 corporate cases tied to forest fires and found indications of foreign involvement. "Out of the 98 cases examined, there is foreign involvement," Suyudi said following a limited cabinet meeting at the Merdeka Palace.

Naming the 11 corporations as suspects serves as a concrete follow-up to that investigation. Polri stated that further suspect designations remain possible as inquiries progress and investigators gather evidence.

This move also complements administrative law enforcement actions already underway, including the revocation and suspension of permits for dozens of companies by the Ministry of Forestry, alongside corporate investigations conducted by Regional Police (Polda) across affected provinces.

item.title: Prabowo: A Thousand Friends Too Few, One Enemy Too Many
item.description: President Prabowo Subianto reaffirmed Indonesia's free and active foreign policy doctrine during a cabinet plenary meeting marking two years of administration.
item.content:encoded:
'Good neighbour' doctrine at plenary session

President Prabowo Subianto stated that Indonesia remains committed to an independent and active foreign policy amidst global uncertainty. Prabowo delivered these remarks while presiding over the Plenary Cabinet Meeting Marking Two Years of the Red and White Cabinet Administration at the Presidential Palace in Central Jakarta on Wednesday (21/10/2026).

Prabowo wants Indonesia to continue being a good neighbor to other nations. He summarized his viewpoint with the phrase: 'a thousand friends are too few, one enemy is too many.' According to him, this foreign policy stance is a tradition inherited from the nation's founding fathers, namely respecting all nations and all major powers.

Following Jokowi's political line since defense minister era

Prabowo stated that he had practiced this principle even before his inauguration as the 8th President of the Republic of Indonesia (RI). At that time, he served as Minister of Defense in the cabinet of Indonesia's 7th President Joko Widodo (Jokowi) and followed the same political line. 'I also followed Mr. Joko Widodo's political line at that time,' he said, noting the desire to foster good relations with all neighboring countries.

He noted that he frequently traveled to build cooperation with various countries and accommodated most of their requests. Despite being welcomed by diverse global powers, Prabowo emphasized that Indonesia firmly holds onto its principles.

Rejecting military pacts and bloc alliances

Prabowo affirmed that Indonesia will not align with any bloc or enter any military pact. 'We do not want to join any bloc, we do not want to join any military pacts,' he emphasized. However, Indonesia continues to respect all parties and avoids entanglement, in line with the mandate of the 1945 Constitution (UUD 1945), which opposes imperialism and colonialism.

He explained that global conditions compel Indonesia to survive and safeguard its natural resources, reminding that national interests must take priority. According to him, this struggle for survival is faced not only by Indonesia, but also by many other nations.

item.title: '98 Volunteer Group Backs Prabowo, Stays Ready to Criticize
item.description: Marking two years of the Prabowo-Gibran administration, the 98 Resolution Network pledged conditional support and vowed open critique if policies harm citizens.
item.content:encoded:
'Real Action' statement on two years of administration

A network calling itself the 98 Resolution Network released a statement entitled 'Real Action of 2 Years of the Prabowo-Gibran Administration: One Resolve to Grow with the People, Prosper Together' on Wednesday (21/10/2026). The volunteer group supporting President Prabowo Subianto and Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka outlined several policies deemed significant milestones during the administration's two-year tenure.

The statement was initiated by Haris Rusly Moti alongside Wahab Talaohu, Eli Salomo Sinaga, and dozens of other activists. Highlighted areas included strengthening the people's economy, managing natural resources, education, health, and providing housing.

Article 33 as the grundnorm of economic democracy

The 98 Resolution Network assessed that the Prabowo-Gibran administration is striving to strengthen economic democracy by placing the public as the primary drivers of development. They linked this policy direction to Article 33 of the UUD 1945 (1945 Constitution), which governs state control over vital sectors of production and natural resources for the greatest prosperity of the people.

According to them, 'if political democratization, freedom, and equality in the political arena do not proceed simultaneously with the economic democratization agenda, what actually emerges is the practice of pseudo-democracy.' The network also warned that a development model reliant on raw material exports and imported consumption goods carries risks. 'Such a model risks positioning Indonesia as a coolie nation among nations,' they wrote.

The statement outlined nine monitoring agendas, ranging from institutionalizing economic democracy and restoring the public as subjects of development, to industrial downstreaming and domestic capital consolidation via BPI Danantara (Daya Anagata Nusantara Investment Management Agency) and DHE (Export Proceeds Foreign Exchange) regulations. Highlighted initiatives included the MBG (Free Nutritious Meal) program, Red and White Village Cooperatives, Red and White Fishing Villages, and subsidized housing.

Conditional support in the style of a critical partner

While declaring support, the 98 Resolution Network emphasized that their backing remains limited and conditional. If government policies are judged contrary to the constitution or detrimental to the broader public interest, they affirmed their intention to voice critical views openly.

The network also asserted they will not assume positions in the cabinet or state institutions, ensuring their oversight role remains independent and sharp. They position themselves as critical partners and part of the public oversight ecosystem, noting guaranteed freedom of expression as a prerequisite for a healthy democracy.

item.title: US Pulls Embassy Staff from Saudi Arabia as Houthi Attacks Intensify
item.description: The United States Department of State on Wednesday (10/21/2026) ordered non-essential personnel and their family members to leave Saudi Arabia. The move came amid intensifying Houthi attacks on Saudi civilian airports and critical infrastructure, including a drone attack on Wednesday that killed two foreign workers at the Shaybah oil field.
item.content:encoded:
State Department issues formal withdrawal order

The United States Department of State on Wednesday (10/21/2026) ordered non-essential personnel and their family members to leave Saudi Arabia. Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott confirmed the order in a post on X.

According to Pigott, the order applies to 'non-emergency US government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only.' He linked the move to attacks by Iran-backed Houthis against Saudi Arabia, including strikes on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure that caused casualties and severe travel disruptions.

'The safety and security of Department personnel and their families remain our highest priority,' Pigott said, as quoted by AFP.

Houthi attacks intensify, two foreign workers killed

On the same day, Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry said debris from the successful interception of a drone targeting an oil facility killed two people — a Filipino and a Nepali — and injured two others. The ministry did not say who launched the drone aimed at the Shaybah oil field near the United Arab Emirates border.

According to AFP, Saudi Arabia has faced near-daily attacks this month from Iran-backed Houthis. Among them was a strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport described as the deadliest attack on the Kingdom in years — the October 13-14 attack that killed 13 people and injured hundreds.

The US Embassy in Riyadh also issued a security alert on Wednesday about possible further Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia. According to CNN, US government employees working in Saudi Arabia now require special authorization from the Chief of Mission to use any airport in the Kingdom following recent missile and drone attacks.

Families of staff in other Gulf states also ordered to leave

A diplomatic source told AFP that 'all American staff and their families have been ordered to depart from the US embassy' in Saudi Arabia, and that families of embassy staff were also ordered to leave the United Arab Emirates, Jordan, Qatar, and Bahrain — countries the source said were targeted by Iran in the Middle East war.

Four US officials speaking to Reuters said US missions in other Gulf states would also order family members to leave. Pigott himself did not address changes at missions outside Saudi Arabia.

Reuters noted Washington had returned some diplomatic personnel to the region in recent months, after many were pulled out when Iran launched attacks on US facilities following the US-Israeli war on Iran that began in late February. AFP said the US previously ordered non-essential staff to leave the Gulf region ahead of the start of its war against Iran and again in July, before President Donald Trump called off a new wave of strikes.

An escalation Indonesians in the Gulf should watch

The withdrawal order marks a serious escalation signal in a conflict rooted in the collapse of Yemen's four-year truce in June. The war triggered by US-Israeli attacks on Iran has snarled global energy trade and shaken Gulf economies.

For Indonesia, Saudi Arabia is a top destination for migrant workers and umrah pilgrims — so the escalation of attacks on airports and public facilities in the Kingdom adds to the list of concerns for Indonesians across the Gulf region.

item.title: Santri Day 2026: Nationwide Ceremony at 7 AM, Theme, and Agenda
item.description: The Ministry of Religious Affairs set National Santri Day 2026 for October 22 with ceremonies at 7 AM under the theme of empowering Islamic students.
item.content:encoded:
Nationwide Ceremony at 7:00 AM Today

The Ministry of Religious Affairs (Kemenag - Kementerian Agama) scheduled the 2026 National Santri Day ceremony to take place simultaneously on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 07:00 local time. The implementation guidelines are outlined in Minister of Religious Affairs Circular Letter Number 6 of 2026, which serves as a reference for ministries and agencies, regional governments, Kemenag offices, Islamic higher education institutions, Islamic mass organizations, pesantren (Islamic boarding schools), Islamic religious education units, santri (Islamic students), and the general public.

To reach a broader audience, the flag-raising ceremony was also broadcast live via the official social media channels of the Ministry of Religious Affairs. Kemenag invited all parties to promote the theme, logo, and series of events through official websites, social media, banners, billboards, and standing banners, while maintaining simplicity and solemnity.

Golden Indonesia Theme and Series of Events

Minister of Religious Affairs Nasaruddin Umar established 'Santri Strengthening the Nation Towards Golden Indonesia' as the central theme for this year's commemoration. Through this theme, pesantren are encouraged not only to preserve Islamic scholarly traditions but also to emerge as a productive generation in various strategic sectors leading toward Golden Indonesia 2045. Meanwhile, PBNU (Pengurus Besar Nahdlatul Ulama - Executive Board of Nahdlatul Ulama) adopted the theme 'Strengthening Traditional Roots, Safeguarding National Integrity'.

The commemoration extends beyond the ceremony. Kemenag guidelines accommodate Santri Scouts, ecotheology activities, and the Pesantren Independence Expo running October 16–24, 2026, showcasing the potential, products, and achievements of Islamic boarding schools to the public. The Santri Letter to the President program, held from September 22 to October 8, 2026, was also part of the series; selected letters were presented to President Prabowo, and the winners were invited to attend the Santri Service Night for the Nation.

History of the 1945 Jihad Resolution

Designating October 22 as Santri Day traces back to the Jihad Resolution declared by KH Hasyim Asy'ari on October 22, 1945. The call urged Muslims to defend Indonesia's independence against the return of colonial rule and formed part of the struggle leading to the Battle of Surabaya in November 1945.

The government designated Santri Day as a national observance through Presidential Decree Number 22 of 2015, signed by President Joko Widodo on October 15, 2015. Since then, the annual commemoration has served as national recognition of the contributions of santri and pesantren throughout the history of Indonesia's independence struggle. Notably, Santri Day is not a public holiday, and government as well as educational activities proceed as usual.

item.title: Lt. Col. Arman Named Suspect in Military Housing Gambling Base Case
item.description: Pomdam Jaya detained Lt. Col. Arman for allegedly leasing military housing in East Jakarta to civilians for an online gambling den. Eleven were arrested.
item.content:encoded:
Lt. Col. Arman Named Suspect and Detained

The Military Police of the Jayakarta Regional Military Command (Pomdam Jaya/Jayakarta) has named Lieutenant Colonel of Infantry (Letkol Inf) Arman a suspect in a case involving the unauthorized leasing of military official housing used as an online gambling headquarters. The suspect designation was announced by the Commander of Pomdam Jaya/Jayakarta (Danpomdam Jaya/Jayakarta), Colonel of Military Police (Kolonel Cpm) Unggul Wahyudi, to journalists at Jakarta Regional Police Headquarters (Polda Metro Jaya) on Wednesday (21/10/2026).

"Yes, he has officially been named a suspect. It is currently being processed. We have detained him at Pomdam. Yes, there are elements of violation regarding the leasing of official housing," Unggul said. Lt. Col. Arman, who serves as the Section Head of Intelligence for Permanent Garrison (Kasi Intel Gartap) 1/Jakarta, is currently being held at Pomdam Jaya for questioning.

Cijantung Official Quarters Turned into Online Gambling Base

The official residence in question is located in the Army Housing Complex (KPAD - Kompleks Perumahan Angkatan Darat) in Cijantung, East Jakarta. The house, owned by the Indonesian Army (TNI AD - Tentara Nasional Indonesia Angkatan Darat), was leased to civilians and allegedly converted into an operational center for online gambling, equipped with computer equipment across several rooms.

"The tenants were ordinary people (civilians), the general public," Unggul said. The case unfolded after the Indonesian Army received reports of suspicious activities within the military residential compound. In early October 2026, personnel from the East Jakarta Military District Command (Kodim 0505/Jakarta Timur) alongside regional units raided the location and seized several items of evidence.

During the bust, 11 civilians consisting of six men and five women were apprehended and taken to the Military Police Detachment (Denpom - Detasemen Polisi Militer) for examination. Officers confiscated 32 computer units, 14 mobile phones, and nine national identity cards (KTP - Kartu Tanda Penduduk) allegedly used to operate the online gambling network.

Indonesian Military Investigates Rogue Personnel Involvement

The Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI - Tentara Nasional Indonesia) is continuing to investigate when the official residence was first leased and repurposed as an online gambling base, including potential involvement of other parties. Head of Information for Kodam Jaya (Kapendam Jaya) Lieutenant Colonel of Artillery (Letkol Arh) Noor Ishak noted that the duration and timeline of the lease remain central to Pomdam Jaya's ongoing inquiry.

Head of the Indonesian Military Information Center (Kapuspen TNI) Brigadier General Muhammad Nas stressed that service members implicated in online gambling will face penalties. "The legal process is underway; sanctions will definitely be handed down commensurate with the gravity of the legal violation," Nas stated. The TNI emphasized that it will not tolerate the misuse of state assets by rogue soldiers.

The case has drawn widespread public scrutiny as it implicates an active mid-ranking officer from the garrison intelligence corps and exploited state assets situated in the heart of a military residential enclave. The Army stated that supervision over official housing assets will be tightened to prevent similar incidents from recurring, pending the outcome of Pomdam Jaya's ongoing investigation.

item.title: Badr MoU: RI, Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan Agree on Defense Pact
item.description: Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed the Badr MoU in Doha on Wednesday (10/21/2026) to boost military production and R&D, Turkey's defense ministry said.
item.content:encoded:
Four Nations Sign Badr MoU in Doha

Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed an agreement to enhance defense cooperation and strengthen defense capabilities on Wednesday (10/21/2026). In an official statement, Turkey's Ministry of National Defense stated that the four nations signed the 'Badr Memorandum of Understanding' in Doha, the capital of Qatar, reflecting their shared desire to deepen cooperation and develop partnerships.

The document was signed by Turkish Minister of National Defense Yasar Guler, Qatar's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defense Affairs Sheikh Saud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani, Indonesian Deputy Minister of Defense Yusuf Jauhari, and Pakistani Minister of Defense Khawaja Muhammad Asif. The signing ceremony was also attended by the President of the Defense Industry Agency of Turkey, Haluk Gorgun.

Focus on Military Production and R&D

The memorandum of understanding named Badr—meaning 'full moon'—aims to enhance cooperation in military production, bolster defense capabilities, and promote collaboration in military technical training, research, and development. Turkey's Ministry of Defense noted that the agreement carries substantial economic value.

'By leveraging the unique military production capabilities of each country, this initiative will facilitate cooperation and integration, enhance defense industry capacity, and meet the needs of allied and friendly nations,' the ministry said in a statement. Gorgun described the agreement as laying the groundwork for 'strategic cooperation' to advance joint production and technology.

Context of Regional Defense Alliances

The Badr agreement comes amid heating regional defense dynamics. Turkey, which commands the second-largest army in NATO and boasts a robust defense industry, has been helping Gulf nations—including Qatar, which hosts a Turkish military base—strengthen their defenses amid the war in Iran.

In August 2026, Turkey also signed a mutual defense pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, under which an attack on one party is considered an attack on all. Turkey also maintains close ties with RI (Republic of Indonesia), particularly in the defense industry sector. The Badr agreement is expected to broaden military cooperation among the four nations while reinforcing ties between their defense industries to support collective security and stability.

Analysts assess that each of the four countries brings distinct strengths: Turkey contributes technological expertise and a mature defense industry, Pakistan and Indonesia offer manufacturing capacity and large domestic markets, while Qatar provides financial depth. This framework opens opportunities for an integrated supply chain to jointly develop, produce, and maintain defense systems.

item.title: Nusron Attends Cabinet Meeting After Twice Skipping KPK Summonses
item.description: Minister Nusron Wahid attended a plenary cabinet meeting on Wednesday, six days after missing two KPK summonses in a Summarecon Agung bribery case.
item.content:encoded:
Skipping KPK, Appearing at the Palace

JAKARTA — Minister of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning/Head of the National Land Agency (ATR/BPN) Nusron Wahid attended a Plenary Cabinet Meeting in the central courtyard of the Presidential Palace, Jakarta, on Wednesday (21/10/2026). The meeting, chaired by President Prabowo Subianto, was held to mark the two-year milestone of the Prabowo-Gibran Rakabuming Raka administration.

Nusron's presence drew scrutiny as it came six days after he failed to comply with two summonses from the Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) for questioning as a witness in an alleged bribery case concerning building use rights (HGB) for PT Summarecon Agung Tbk.

According to a YouTube broadcast by the Presidential Secretariat, Nusron was seen wearing a white shirt and a black peci (traditional cap). He sat in the third row at a desk designated by his nameplate as Minister of ATR/BPN.

Unseen by Media at Main Entrance

Nusron's arrival went unnoticed by media crews stationed at the main gate of the Palace complex. His presence was only discovered once he was already at the cabinet meeting venue.

He sat adjacent to several state officials, including Minister of Manpower Yassierli, Head of the Special Development Control and Investigation Agency (Bappisus) Aris Marsudiyanto, Head of the National Development Planning Agency (Bappenas) Rachmat Pambudy, and Head of the National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) Lt. Gen. Kristomei Sianturi.

Previously, Nusron was not seen passing through the pillared entrance typically used by ministers of the Red and White Cabinet to access the event venue.

Skipped Twice: October 7 and 15

The KPK first scheduled Nusron's examination for Wednesday (7/10/2026). He did not attend, citing an internal agenda at the Ministry of ATR/BPN.

Investigators then rescheduled the questioning for Thursday (15/10/2026). Nusron again failed to appear; he was said to be in Malaysia for an official duty trip. The KPK briefly classified the absence as skipping without notice because it had not received official confirmation on the day of the summons.

“Naturally, all the reasons submitted will be reviewed and analyzed by investigators regarding their propriety,” said KPK Spokesperson Budi Prasetyo at the KPK Red and White Building on Tuesday (20/10/2026).

KPK Weighs Next Summons

Budi stated that investigators are still weighing next steps to obtain the necessary testimony from Nusron, including the possibility of issuing a follow-up summons accompanied by a warrant to bring him in.

“Of course, we hope that the person concerned will be cooperative in the legal process, particularly regarding matters related to this Ministry of ATR/BPN,” Budi said.

The KPK also clarified that it cannot yet request an overseas travel ban against Nusron because his status is still that of a witness. Under the Criminal Procedure Code (KUHAP), travel bans can only be imposed on suspects.

This case involves alleged bribery in obtaining HGB permits for PT Summarecon Agung Tbk in Bogor Regency. The KPK has named eight suspects, including the President Director of PT Summarecon Agung Tbk, Adrianto Pitojo Adhi. In a sting operation on September 14, 2026, the KPK seized approximately Rp106.3 billion in cash.

The KPK additionally denied a viral video claiming Nusron was forcibly picked up at Soekarno-Hatta Airport. Budi emphasized that the footage did not depict actions taken by KPK investigators.

item.title: Oil Surges to US$110 After Dammam Airport and Shaybah Attacked
item.description: Wednesday night (21/10/2026) attacks struck King Fahd International Airport in Dammam and the Saudi Aramco-operated Shaybah oil field. Three people were killed and ten others injured; the United States ordered diplomats and non-emergency family members to leave Saudi Arabia, while Brent crude surged past US$110 a barrel.
item.content:encoded:
Twin Attacks on Wednesday Night

RIYADH — Two strategic Saudi Arabian facilities came under attack in a single night on Wednesday (21/10/2026) local time: King Fahd International Airport in Dammam and the Saudi Aramco-operated Shaybah oil field. Three people were killed and ten injured in the two incidents, as the conflict between Yemen's Houthi group and the Saudi-led coalition heats up.

The Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) confirmed one person was killed and eight others injured in the attack on King Fahd International Airport. According to GACA, the victims' injuries ranged from minor to severe. The wounded were taken to hospital, while assessment of material damage at the airport facility is ongoing.

GACA has not disclosed the nature of the attack or who was responsible. Further details are promised once the investigation is complete.

Drone to Shaybah Intercepted, Debris Kills 2 Workers

Separately, the Saudi Ministry of Energy reported two people killed and two others injured by falling drone debris near the Shaybah oil field. Air defenses successfully intercepted a drone targeting the Aramco facility, but the falling debris killed two workers — a Filipino national and a Nepalese national.

The ministry said the debris also set fire to a contractor's vehicle at the site. Nevertheless, operations at the Shaybah oil field in the Eastern Province, near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) border, were stated to be normal.

The Saudi-led coalition claimed it destroyed five drones launched toward several areas of the kingdom, including the Eastern Province and the Medina region.

US Orders Embassy Staff to Leave

In response to the deteriorating security situation, the United States Department of State ordered diplomats and non-emergency family members to depart Saudi Arabia on Wednesday (21/10). US officials said plans are underway to withdraw family members from several other US missions in the region.

The US Embassy in Riyadh also issued an urgent security alert warning US citizens and personnel about the high likelihood of further Houthi attacks targeting locations across Saudi Arabia.

Oil Prices Surge to US$110

The deadly attacks on energy infrastructure immediately shook markets. Brent crude, the global benchmark, rose about 1.1 percent to break above US$110 a barrel in post-settlement trading. WTI crude climbed to around US$98 a barrel.

Brent has surged about 80 percent this year after the US-Iran war disrupted energy flows from the Persian Gulf — a conflict now in its ninth month with no end in sight. Each new attack adds to the risk premium: cargo insurance premiums, vessel rerouting costs, and hedging expenses for operators.

Escalating Houthi Attacks

Wednesday night's incident was the second attack on King Fahd International Airport this month, after one on October 11, 2026. Attacks on Saudi airports have intensified in recent weeks.

On October 10, an attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh killed 12 people and injured more than 300, according to GACA data. A follow-up attack on October 11 struck the same airport again, killing one Pakistani national and injuring 11. Saudi authorities have not yet named those responsible for the latest Dammam attack.

item.title: Dortmund Beat Sabah 2-1, Guirassy Scores Twice
item.description: Borussia Dortmund beat Sabah Masazir 2-1 in Baku on Champions League matchday 3 on Tuesday (20/10/2026). Serhou Guirassy scored twice (10', 53') after Aden McCarthy had equalised in the 39th minute. Dortmund's first away UCL win in almost a year takes them to 6 points and ends a three-match winless run.
item.content:encoded:
Guirassy Puts Dortmund Ahead, McCarthy Equalises

Borussia Dortmund defeated Sabah Masazir 2-1 in UEFA Champions League 2026/2027 league-phase matchday 3 at Baku Olympic Stadium on Tuesday (20/10/2026). Serhou Guirassy's brace secured Die Borussen's first away win in the competition in almost a year.

Dortmund took the lead in the 10th minute. Felix Nmecha's fierce effort was parried by Sabah keeper Stas Pokatilov, and Guirassy was quickest to the rebound to make it 1-0.

The hosts, founded only in 2017, refused to fold. In the 39th minute, Aden McCarthy rose to head home Tymoteusz Puchacz's free-kick delivery. The 1-1 scoreline held until the break — and the Baku crowd dared to dream.

Guirassy's Second-Half Strike Proves Decisive

Dortmund came out stronger after the interval and retook the lead in the 53rd minute. Joey Veerman swung in a precise cross, and Guirassy met it with his left foot to make it 2-1.

Sabah pushed for an equaliser in the closing stages, but Niko Kovac's well-marshalled defence held firm until the final whistle. Dortmund took all three points back from Azerbaijan.

The stats reflected the visitors' dominance: 59 percent possession and 14 shots with six on target, against Sabah's seven shots (three on target).

Winless Run Ends, Dortmund Move to 6 Points

The victory ended Dortmund's three-match winless run in all competitions, which included the painful 0-1 defeat to Bodo/Glimt on matchday 2. It was also their first away Champions League win in almost a year — their last coming on 21 October 2025 in a 4-2 victory at FC Copenhagen.

With three more points, Dortmund now have six from three matches and are back on course in the race for the round of 16. Sabah remain on three points.

Guirassy was once again Dortmund's hero: the Guinea striker also scored twice in the 3-2 win over Villarreal on the opening matchday. His European form will be vital for Kovac's side in the big games ahead.

item.title: Fenerbahce Throw Away Win, Held 2-2 by Slavia Prague
item.description: Fenerbahce drew 2-2 with Slavia Prague in Istanbul on Champions League matchday 3 on Tuesday (20/10/2026). The hosts led through Oguz Aydin (4') and Mason Greenwood (11'), but Slavia replied via Lukas Provod (15') and Pavel Kacor's 90th-minute equaliser. Fenerbahce remain winless in three games.
item.content:encoded:
Fenerbahce Race Into 2-0 Lead Inside 11 Minutes

Fenerbahce were held to a 2-2 draw by Slavia Prague in UEFA Champions League 2026/2027 league-phase matchday 3 at Chobani Stadium, Istanbul, on Tuesday (20/10/2026). The hosts threw away a two-goal lead built inside the opening 11 minutes.

Only four minutes were on the clock when Oğuz Aydın fired Fenerbahce 1-0 up, finishing off Milan Skriniar's pass. Seven minutes later, Mason Greenwood doubled the advantage with a clinical finish after linking up with Nelson Semedo — 2-0 to the home side.

The perfect start had the Istanbul crowd roaring. Fenerbahce looked confident after last week's 6-0 humiliation at Aston Villa, and a first league-phase win seemed only a matter of time.

Provod Pulls One Back, Kacor Strikes Late

Slavia refused to lie down. In the 15th minute, Lukáš Provod halved the deficit to 2-1 after Mateo Guendouzi committed a horror error, losing the ball on the edge of his own box — a blunder the visitors ruthlessly punished.

The 2-1 scoreline held until half-time. Fenerbahce tried to control the game in the second half, but Slavia kept pressing for an equaliser.

The drama came at the death. In the 90th minute, Pavel Kacor struck the equaliser to silence Chobani Stadium. Slavia, 2-0 down early on, left with a precious point.

Fenerbahce Still Winless

The draw extends Fenerbahce's poor start in this season's Champions League. The Portuguese-coached side drew 1-1 with AS Roma on the opening matchday before being hammered 6-0 by Aston Villa — and now failed to win again despite leading by two goals.

Slavia Prague are also yet to taste victory: the Czech side lost 2-3 to Lens and 0-2 to Sabah in their first two games. But a point in Istanbul is valuable capital for climbing the league-phase table.

For a Fenerbahce side boasting big names like Ederson, N'Golo Kante and Romelu Lukaku, the pressure is mounting. Three games without a win leaves their round-of-16 hopes fading.

item.title: Papua's Raja Ampat: The World's Ultimate Underwater Paradise
item.description: Raja Ampat in Southwest Papua sits at the Coral Triangle's heart, hosting 1,300+ fish and 600 coral species. Here is your travel guide via Sorong.
item.content:encoded:
Raja Ampat, Heart of the Coral Triangle

Raja Ampat — meaning 'Four Kings' — is an archipelago of roughly 1,500 islands off the coast of Southwest Papua, Indonesia. Its name refers to four main islands: Waigeo, Misool, Salawati, and Batanta. The archipelago lies right in the heart of the Coral Triangle, an area recognized for possessing the highest marine biodiversity on the planet.

The waters of Raja Ampat are home to more than 1,300 fish species and around 600 coral species — equivalent to 75 percent of the world's known coral species. Scientists describe it as the richest coral reef ecosystem on Earth, and new species continue to be discovered to this day.

Encountering Mantas, Wobbegongs, and Pygmy Seahorses

For divers and snorkelers, every dive in Raja Ampat feels like an underwater safari. Giant manta rays frequently glide past cleaning stations, wobbegong sharks conceal themselves in reef crevices, while sea turtles and pygmy seahorses remain prime targets for macro photographers.

The wonder does not end beneath the surface. Clusters of karst islands rising above turquoise waters, dense rainforests, secluded lagoons, and red birds-of-paradise make Raja Ampat a complete destination for nature enthusiasts — even for non-divers.

Getting to Raja Ampat: Fly to Sorong, Ferry to Waisai

The primary gateway to Raja Ampat is the city of Sorong. Travelers fly into Domine Eduard Osok Airport from Jakarta, Makassar, Manado, or Bali, then continue their journey via public ferry or speedboat for approximately two hours to Waisai, the capital of Raja Ampat Regency on Waigeo Island.

Every foreign visitor entering Raja Ampat's waters — whether for diving or snorkeling — is required to purchase a marine park conservation permit valid for one year. Revenue generated from this permit directly funds local ranger patrols and conservation initiatives throughout the area.

Best Time to Visit: October to April

The optimal time to visit Raja Ampat is between October and April, when the seas are calmer, skies are clear, and underwater visibility reaches 15–30 meters with water temperatures between 27–29 degrees Celsius. The period from December to February marks the peak season, with manta ray activity at its height from December to March.

Do not miss the iconic panoramic vista from the summit of Piaynemo — a collection of verdant karst islands perched above turquoise seas — alongside Wayag in the north and Misool in the south. Given the journey's distance, allocate at least seven to ten days to thoroughly explore the archipelago.
